items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment. Do not add discretionary production work, prototypes, site-factory admissions, or spend while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots and financial evidence is insufficient. Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission, all unattributed to sites. Named site-attributed commission is $0. Revenue claims, ROI, and causal lift are therefore unsupported. September AI usage is $1,002.46 across 5,531 calls, including 234 errors; known AI spend alone exceeds the reported commission by $997.54. Full contribution margin cannot be calculated because fixed infrastructure, hosting, domain, labor, and other operating costs are absent, and the revenue period does not match the September AI-cost window. Preserve only the existing capacity-gated allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after the saveusfarms.com repair case releases a slot; measure clicks only and do not forecast revenue.

Finance disposition: AI cost is measurable, but total infrastructure spend and contribution margin are not. Existing evidence reports $1,002.46 AI cost for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30, but no Cloudflare/hosting, domains, labor, or other operating-cost ledger is present. Minimum measurement needed for monthly contribution margin: same-period infrastructure cost by site or fleet, plus a dated revenue extract covering the identical period with registered site tracking IDs. Until then, classify margin and budget exposure as unknown; do not treat AI-only margin fields as full contribution margin. This is report-only evidence work; no billing, banking, credentials, or spend changes are authorized.
